title: V1 versus V2 wire format
caption: V2 moved the payment requirements from the 402 body into a header, renamed every header, switched network names to CAIP-2 ids and renamed the price field. Both values of x402Version still exist, so check which one a server speaks.
alt: Two rows. V1: a 402 response with a JSON body PaymentRequirementsResponse, a retry with the X-PAYMENT header, and an X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE header; networks are names such as base-sepolia and the price field is maxAmountRequired. V2: a 402 response with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, a retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, and a PAYMENT-RESPONSE header; networks are CAIP-2 ids such as eip155:84532, the price field is amount, ResourceInfo is a separate object and extensions exist. An arrow labeled migration guide points from V1 to V2.
